summary: RLS system-path marker migration down() is byte-identical to prior policies (verified against 20260701000003/20260817000002); DunningService always uses real tenant context (never role:system) so unaffected; grepped all writers of webhook_events/payment_events/tenant_billing_state -- all route through billing-enforcement.service.ts, called only from handleWebhook (now correctly wrapped with role:system when no tenant resolves) or from admin controller routes gated by the pre-existing global RequestTenantContextInterceptor (unchanged tenant-match semantics before/after this diff -- not a regression it introduces). ON CONFLICT...WHERE...RETURNING semantics for the out-of-order subscription fix are correct per Postgres (false WHERE clause on DO UPDATE yields zero returned rows, no throw); same-period status changes still apply per the >= guard. HOWEVER found a reproducible functional regression in the idempotent-side-effects fix (find-0b089515): onCheckoutCompleted's new alreadyActive guard reads org.billing_status BEFORE the write and treats billing_status==='active' as proof this is a reclaimed retry. But billing_status is plan-agnostic -- a genuine second checkout for an org already on an active plan (e.g. professional to enterprise upgrade) ALSO has billing_status==='active' beforehand, since Stripe event-id dedup (recordWebhookProcessed) already filters true same-event retries upstream and never reaches onCheckoutCompleted for those. So a real upgrade correctly updates billing_subscriptions/tenants/organizations and calls enforcement.activateTenant, but then silently skips ws.sendToTenant('billing:plan_upgraded', ...) and DOMAIN_EVENTS.TENANT_CREATED -- the user/UI never learns of a real plan upgrade via realtime or domain event. The new spec test only covers the retry-after-partial-failure scenario, never a genuine second checkout while already active, so this gap ships untested. Filed as find-9fd92b12; recommend keying the guard on (event.id already applied) or comparing previous plan/price, not billing_status alone.
